questions.question: What does the fool say in his heart?
What did the LORD see when he looked down on mankind?
options: Many who seek the LORD with their whole heart
None who does good, no, not one
Wise rulers who govern the nations
A faithful remnant kept for himself
questions.answer: None who does good, no, not one

questions.question: The psalm longs for salvation for Israel to come out of Zion.
